"""Bounded real bootstrap consumer and missing spend bridge witness."""
import copy
import json
from decimal import Decimal
from polisyos.scientist.methods.search.funnel.level3_medium import Level3MediumFidelity
from polisyos.scientist.methods.search.funnel.level4_full import Level4FullFidelity
from polisyos.scientist.methods.search.funnel.orchestrator import FunnelOrchestrator
from polisyos.scientist.orchestration.engine.budget import BudgetLimit, BudgetState
from tests.unit.scientist.search.funnel.test_orchestrator import _bootstrap_workflow, _bootstrap_context
candidate={'candidate_id':'bounded-mean-fixture'}
context=_bootstrap_context();original=copy.deepcopy(context)
direct_observations=[]
direct=Level4FullFidelity(_bootstrap_workflow(direct_observations)).evaluate(candidate,context)
chained_observations=[]
engine=_bootstrap_workflow(chained_observations)
budget=BudgetState(limits={'run':BudgetLimit(key='run',max_usd=Decimal('5'))})
orch=FunnelOrchestrator([Level3MediumFidelity(engine),Level4FullFidelity(engine)],budget_state=budget)
outcome=orch.advance(orch.submit(candidate,context),policy='full')
print(json.dumps({'workflow':'SimpleLoopEngine estimate reads data_config and estimation_config -> Foundry bootstrap_mean_interval seed17',
 'synthetic_input':'integers1..120; full fraction1; full n_bootstrap120',
 'direct_observations':direct_observations,'chained_observations':chained_observations,
 'full_output_equal':direct.simulation_results==outcome.final_result.simulation_results,
 'caller_context_unchanged':context==original,
 'direct_output':direct.simulation_results,'final_action':outcome.final_action,
 'reported_total_cost_usd':outcome.compute_actual_usd,'routing_budget_remaining_run':str(budget.remaining('run')),
 'routing_budget_spent':{k:str(v) for k,v in budget.spent.items()},
 'native_adapter_limitation':'_PolicyRuntimeWorkflowEngine pins medium/full fidelity and does not consume this generic workflow data/bootstrap configuration'},indent=2))
assert direct_observations[0][:2]==(120,120)
assert [o[:2] for o in chained_observations]==[(24,50),(120,120)]
assert direct.simulation_results==outcome.final_result.simulation_results
assert budget.remaining('run')==Decimal('5') and budget.spent=={}
